_readme: MFLAC files with a QTag or V1 footer carry their key inline.
Only modern 'musicex' containers (QQ Music >= 19.57) need an entry here.
This file ships empty on purpose: no key material is distributed with
the application. Populate it yourself, or drop a sidecar <song>.mflac.ekey
next to the audio, or paste an ekey in the UI.
